meadow.webp.source: Built-in image_gen edit of the user-supplied landscape reference
meadow.webp.prompt: Edit target: the supplied screenshot of a landscape login page. Extract and restore ONLY its scenic background artwork as a clean full-bleed wide 3:2 image. Preserve the exact visible landscape composition and hand-colored fine ink engraving/watercolor style: tall umbrella pine on the left, smaller windswept trees across the horizon, light yellow-green golf fairway curling through pale sand bunkers in foreground, detailed dark sage-green trees on right, very pale almost-white blue sky above. Remove ALL website UI: login card, fields, text, logos, navigation, black rounded monitor border, gray outer margins. Reconstruct the portion of the trees and landscape hidden behind the form to fit seamlessly. Keep the large open pale sky occupying upper 55-60% for an HTML form overlay, landscape filling lower40-45%, prominent left pine reaches up to aboutmidheight. No people, deer, text, frame or new objects. This is an asset for the user's existing website, not a new UI mockup.

deer-sprite.webp.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent PNG sprite sheet for a tiny interactive deer in a quiet hand-colored landscape engraving website. Very wide horizontal sheet, aspect ratio 6:1, SIX equal square cells in ONE row, exactly SIX full-body illustrations of the SAME small elegant brown fallow deer in right-facing side profile. Keep same scale, same body/head center position, same eye line, same baseline and same generous transparent padding in each cell, no parts crossing cell boundaries. Warm chestnut fur, subtle cream spots, dark fine ink outline, small branched antlers, four thin graceful legs. Detailed natural-history watercolor/engraving appearance, not cartoon, no emoji. Frame1 calm standing pose. Frames2-6 coherent running gallop cycle: gathered legs, front reach, extended airborne, front landing, rear push. Keep all frames centered with entire antlers hooves tail visible. Transparent background, no ground, no shadows, no text, no numbers, no gridlines, no decorative elements. Asset will be displayed at 65px tall; prioritize a readable deer silhouette. All six deer face right.

deer-walk.webp.prompt: Produce a clean transparent animation sprite sheet: exactly TWENTY frames in 5 columns by 4 rows. Image 1 supplies the SAME CHARACTER to preserve: its small narrow branching antlers, warm chestnut spotted fur, head shape, watercolor illustration. Image 2 supplies the WALK LEG MOTION to preserve: clearly reaching front leg, planted straight leg, front leg trailing backward beneath belly, bent-knee lifted passing leg; hind legs also reach, plant, trail, and lift. Use the image1 deer identity but image2 FULL leg motion. Create 20 sequential in-between phases across one complete two-sided four-beat walking cycle. Do NOT copy image1's motionless stance. Use image2's broad alternating leg silhouettes, with noticeably extended and folded limbs. Stable same torso, head, tail and antlers across all frames, full right-facing side profile. In each equal cell, center the torso at the same location with hooves on same baseline; full animal including antlers inside cell with generous transparent margins. Body doesn't float or bounce, no gallop, at least two feet on ground at a time. Transparent alpha, no text, grid, labels, shadows, or scenery. Twenty distinct sequential full-range WALK poses. Same small-antler deer as image1.
deer-walk.webp.alphaEditPrompt: Remove the brown background from this sprite sheet completely. Preserve all TWENTY deer exactly, including every individual leg pose, antler, hoof, coat marking, their current positions and scale. Output genuinely transparent alpha in all gaps, between legs, and around antlers. No new artwork, no backdrop, no shadow, no colors outside the deer, no text. Keep 5 columns and 4 rows with all twenty complete animals. This is a background-removal edit only.

deer-idle.webp.prompt: An animation production sprite sheet of a small spotted fallow buck STANDING STILL AND CHEWING CUD. Exactly EIGHT full-body right-facing deer in a 4-column x 2-row regular grid. Same natural-history watercolor and fine ink illustration as the reference. In ALL eight frames the four hooves are planted in exactly the same neutral relaxed stance, legs vertical beneath the body, absolutely no walking. Same body, head position, antlers, coat spots and size throughout. Only the MOUTH AND LOWER JAW animate: frame1 mouth closed, frame2 lower jaw slightly drops, frame3 lower lip drops and jaw shifts forward, frame4 jaw shifts gently sideways, frame5 closed chewing compression, frame6 jaw drops again, frame7 lips close, frame8 neutral. Clearly readable small dark mouth opening and lower jaw movement, not smiling and not a huge cartoon mouth. A tiny blade of grass stays at the corner of its mouth. Subtle breathing and one small ear twitch allowed, but no positional drift. Eight sequential poses of one natural ruminating loop. Full antlers/hooves within each cell, 15% transparent padding around every sprite. Transparent alpha background, no grid, text, scenery, cast shadows or labels. Landscape sheet, 2:1 aspect. Reference is character and style only; standing planted legs and chewing action are the required new poses.
